name: edge-256
description: Hypothetical microcontroller-class NPU sized from public data on the Ethos-U55 top configuration (Arm Ethos-U product brief: 256 MACs, 18 to 50 KB internal SRAM, two 64-bit AXI, throughput quoted at 1 GHz). 16x16 output-stationary array: 256 MAC/cycle, 512 GOP/s at 1 GHz and 2 ops/MAC. SRAM 50 KiB, the top U55 figure. One 64-bit AXI port to external DRAM that holds every tensor, where Arm's Corstone-300 reference platform places the model and tensor arena by default; the read-only flash port is not modeled. DRAM from Vela 5.2.0 Ethos_U65_Mid_End, the DRAM-attached system of the U55's sibling, in NPU cycles as Vela states it: the 16 B port x Dram_clock_scale 0.46875 is 7.5 B/cycle (3.75 GB/s at Vela's 500 MHz), of which 8 B/cycle is the smallest integer rate that reaches it, 8 GB/s at 1 GHz; 500-cycle read and 250-cycle write latency; 12 reads and 6 writes outstanding. Bursts up to 64 beats, the shortest power of two with which 12 outstanding reads cover 500 cycles. Tiles 32x32x128: the largest power-of-two square tile whose two slots of two panel buffers fit with panels at least 128 B deep (Vela Dram_burst_length); the 7936 B left over is the weight cache. Depthwise datapath 24 MAC/cycle, the 3x3 rate of Vela 5.2.0's Ethos-U55-256 performance model: a 2x2x8 output microblock takes 4 kernel taps per 4-cycle step, so 9 taps take 3 steps (32 MAC/cycle peak, three quarters of it for 3x3). Pipeline 4 cycles per panel, the simulator default.
